raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#43465 (@At1a8) enables prefill context parallel (CP) for DeepSeek-V4.1 on HIP. Serving DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with it on MI355X under long-context, mixed-length load, we hit three remaining gaps, which this PR closes:

1. **GPU memory fault at concurrency 64.** Under CP, a request group can own no rows on a rank (e.g. a one-token extend lands on another rank). The HIP low-ratio indexer still launched the fp4 prefill logits kernel for that group, and with 0 rows the kernel reads a null page table (address 0). The kernel-side issue is ROCm/aiter#6562.
2. **`--enable-cp-decode-attn-tp` does not work for DeepSeek-V4.1.** On gfx950, the V4.1 block-fp8 linears run from scale copies derived at load time (`weight_scale_mx_e8m0`, `weight_scale_inv_mx`, `weight_bf16`), which were not narrowed along with the weight.
3. **Image requests are wrong under CP.** The CP runner drives the language model directly, so image spans never reached the embeddings, and image pad hashes reached Engram / hash / vision routing unmapped.

### Relation to #43465

The first commit is #43465's change at its current head `6b04a79c` (author Wang, FangYuan), squashed onto main. It is carried only so this PR builds and tests on its own, and it drops out on rebase once #43465 merges. **Please review only the last two commits.** If the author of #43465 prefers, the two commits can also be folded into #43465.

## Modifications

1. `[AMD] DeepSeek-v4.1: Support prefill context parallel`: #43465 (head `6b04a79c`), unchanged.
2. **Zero-row groups and MXFP8 scale slicing**:
   - `low_ratio_backend_hip.py`: skip a request group that has no rows on this rank and publish no candidate mask for it (with 0 rows the fp4 logits kernel reads a null page table, and top-k cannot launch on an empty batch);
   - `cp_decode_attn_tp.py`: when narrowing the attention linears per rank, slice the gfx950 scale copies on the same dim as the weight; reject the MXFP8-native route, whose weights are pre-shuffled into scaled-MFMA lane order at load time and cannot be narrowed, with an error that names `--fp8-gemm-backend aiter` or `triton`;
   - tests: `test_dsv41_low_ratio_zero_row_hip.py`, `test_cp_decode_attn_tp.py`.
3. **Image inputs under CP**:
   - `DeepseekV4ForCausalLM.prepare_cp_inputs` reuses `prepare_language_model_inputs` to prepare the image embeddings and the remapped ids on the whole sequence before sharding; the CP runner shards them and hands the ids the hook returns to the logits step;
   - under the late-layer tail, the ids the MoE routes are gathered like its hidden states (local rows under MoE A2A); the DP attention branch is unchanged;
   - test: `test_eager_runner_cp_inputs.py`.

## Supported scope and limitations

- Validated only on ROCm gfx950 (MI355X).
- The vision tower itself is **not** context-parallel: every CP rank runs it on the whole sequence, as every TP rank does today. Vision under CP is only allowed without MoE A2A.
- `--enable-cp-decode-attn-tp` needs `--fp8-gemm-backend aiter` (or `triton`). With the default `auto`, gfx950 takes the MXFP8-native route and the server refuses to start with a `NotImplementedError` that names the fix.
- CP on HIP does not support the breakable prefill CUDA graph; all runs below use `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled`.
- The zero-row skip is a framework-side guard; the kernel-side fix is tracked in ROCm/aiter#6562. The page-8 row-group fp4 indexer added on main (`SGLANG_HIP_DSV41_INDEX_K_PAGE8`, off by default) was not run with CP.
- Two cases of `test/registered/cp/test_cp_strategy_unit.py` fail on a ROCm GPU because of #43465's HIP 16-token floor (they fail with #43465 alone as well); this test runs on CPU only in CI.

## Accuracy Tests

Setup: MI355X, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm720-mi35x-20261015` with the branch's whole `python/sglang` mounted over the image's, this PR on main `617c8b67b`, model default context (1M), paged FP8 KV. sgl-eval 0.1.3 with the settings of `test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300.py` (`--load-preset-from-model-id deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --num-threads 64`, GSM8K all 1319 questions with `--max-tokens 4096`).

The InferenceY DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP4 recipe (`--speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5`, `--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay`, `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled`, `--prefill-decode-interval 96`, `--swa-prefix-tails 1024`, `--max-running-requests 32`, `--mem-fraction-static 0.70`, `--fp8-gemm-backend aiter`, INT8 quick reduce, OPUS sparse prefill), without and with `--enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy interleave --enable-cp-decode-attn-tp` (CP4), both servers on one node at the same time; acceptance length is the server's `accept len`, averaged over the GSM8K run:

| Configuration | GSM8K | Acceptance length |
|---|---|---|
| TP4 + DSpark | 96.36% | 3.52 |
| TP4 + DSpark + CP4 + decode-attn TP (this PR) | 96.21% | 3.49 |

Without DSpark, vision tower built, TP8 (`--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled --fp8-gemm-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --max-running-requests 64 --mem-fraction-static 0.85`), without and with `--enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy interleave` (CP8); MMMU-Pro with 200 questions and `--max-tokens 32768` (the model preset), which exercises the image inputs of commit 3:

| Configuration | GSM8K | MMMU-Pro (image inputs) |
|---|---|---|
| TP8, no CP | 96.59% | 74.50% |
| TP8 + CP8 (this PR) | 96.21% | 78.00% |

A 200-question MMMU-Pro sample moves by a few points between runs.

No server faults or NaN in any run. Without commit 2, a ~600k-token request batched with a one-token extend under CP4 faults at address 0 every time; with it, the batch completes.

Unit tests: the three new test files pass; on the commits without the corresponding fix, the new cases fail.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

This PR fixes functionality; the prefill CP speedup itself is #43465's. `--enable-cp-decode-attn-tp`, which works for DeepSeek-V4.1 with commit 2, shards attention over the CP group in decode.

The servers of the table above; `bench_serving` with random token ids, 5 x concurrency requests (at least 16), the radix cache flushed before every run (random-ids prompts of one seed are prefixes of each other across runs, so an earlier run would otherwise warm the next one). Output tok/s and mean TTFT:

| Input / output | Concurrency | TP4 + DSpark | + CP4 + decode-attn TP |
|---|---|---|---|
| 64k / 1k | 1 | 416.8, 1.02 s | 446.1 (+7%), 0.96 s (-6%) |
| 64k / 1k | 4 | 414.9, 7.49 s | 489.4 (+18%), 6.17 s (-18%) |
| 64k / 1k | 8 | 479.6, 14.09 s | 509.6 (+6%), 13.18 s (-6%) |
| 64k / 1k | 16 | 477.6, 29.65 s | 497.2 (+4%), 28.44 s (-4%) |
| 8k / 1k | 1 | 681.4, 0.14 s | 659.1 (-3%), 0.14 s |
| 8k / 1k | 16 | 1810.7, 6.19 s | 1822.2 (+1%), 6.01 s (-3%) |

With 64k inputs, CP shortens the prefill that the queue waits on: 4–18% higher output throughput and 4–18% lower mean TTFT. With 8k inputs the two are within 3%; a single short request gains nothing from CP. Each point is a single run, and with DSpark the throughput also moves with the acceptance of the generated text.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4 import low_ratio_backend_hip as m
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=3, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+TOPK = 8
+
+
+def _run_extend(rows_per_request, rows_per_chunk):
+    """Run the HIP low-ratio extend indexer with the scoring and top-k kernels
+    replaced; returns the row counts scored and the published candidate masks."""
+    num_tokens = sum(rows_per_request)
+    num_reqs = len(rows_per_request)
+    indexer_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+        page_table=torch.zeros((num_tokens, 4), dtype=torch.int32),
+        compressed_seq_lens=torch.ones(num_tokens, dtype=torch.int32),
+        compressed_page_size=64,
+    )
+    page_indices = torch.zeros((num_tokens, TOPK), dtype=torch.int32)
+    backend = SimpleNamespace(
+        token_to_kv_pool=SimpleNamespace(
+            get_index_k_fp4_payload_buffer=lambda layer_id: None,
+            get_index_k_fp4_scale_buffer=lambda layer_id: None,
+            low_ratio_index_k_page8=lambda layer_id: False,
+        ),
+        forward_metadata=SimpleNamespace(
+            core_metadata=SimpleNamespace(
+                sparse_page_indices=lambda ratio: page_indices,
+                sparse_raw_indices=lambda ratio: None,
+            ),
+            late_layer_tail=None,
+            low_ratio_indexer_metadata=lambda ratio: indexer_metadata,
+            fp4_low_ratio_prefill_workspaces={},
+        ),
+        low_ratio_identity_skip=False,
+        candidate_masks=None,
+    )
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(
+        compress_ratio=1,
+        layer_id=0,
+        indexer=SimpleNamespace(
+            is_candidate_source=True, uses_candidates=False, index_topk=TOPK
+        ),
+    )
+    forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(seq_lens_cpu=[1000] * num_reqs)
+    scored_rows = []
+
+    def fake_logits(**kw):
+        scored_rows.append(kw["q_fp4"].shape[0])
+        return torch.zeros((kw["q_fp4"].shape[0], 16))
+
+    def fake_select(**kw):
+        kw["publish"].append(("mask", kw["page_indices"].shape[0]))
+
+    inputs = (
+        torch.zeros((num_tokens, 64, 64), dtype=torch.uint8),
+        torch.zeros((num_tokens, 1, 4, 16, 4), dtype=torch.uint8),
+        torch.zeros((num_tokens, 64)),
+    )
+    with (
+        mock.patch.object(m, "_indexer_inputs", return_value=inputs),
+        mock.patch.object(m, "logits_rows_per_chunk", return_value=rows_per_chunk),
+        mock.patch.object(m, "aiter_fp4_paged_mqa_logits", side_effect=fake_logits),
+        mock.patch.object(m, "_select_topk_extend_hip", side_effect=fake_select),
+        mock.patch.object(
+            m, "cat_candidate_blocks", side_effect=lambda pieces: ("cat", pieces)
+        ),
+    ):
+        m.low_ratio_index_topk_hip_extend(
+            backend,
+            layer,
+            x=None,
+            q_lora=None,
+            pos=torch.arange(990, 990 + num_tokens),
+            forward_batch=forward_batch,
+            rows_per_request=rows_per_request,
+        )
+    return scored_rows, backend.candidate_masks
+
+
+class TestLowRatioZeroRowGroup(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_zero_row_group_is_not_scored(self):
+        """Prefill CP: a one-token extend owned by the other rank, next to a request
+        wider than the logits block, formed a group with no rows here; scoring it
+        launched the fp4 prefill logits kernel on 0 rows (GPU fault at address 0)."""
+        self.assertEqual(m._request_groups([0, 3], 2), [(0, 1, 0, 0), (1, 2, 0, 3)])
+        scored_rows, masks = _run_extend([0, 3], rows_per_chunk=2)
+        self.assertEqual(scored_rows, [2, 1])
+        self.assertEqual(masks, [None, ("cat", [("mask", 2), ("mask", 1)])])
+
+    def test_zero_row_request_sharing_a_group_is_scored_with_it(self):
+        self.assertEqual(m._request_groups([0, 2, 1], 4), [(0, 3, 0, 3)])
+        scored_rows, masks = _run_extend([0, 2, 1], rows_per_chunk=4)
+        self.assertEqual(scored_rows, [3])
+        self.assertEqual(masks, [("mask", 3)])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+N, K = 256, 256

+def _context(rank=1, size=2):

+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(linear)
+    linear.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+        torch.arange(N * K, dtype=torch.float32).view(N, K), requires_grad=False
+    )
+    linear.weight_scale_inv = torch.arange(4.0).view(N // 128, K // 128)

+import contextlib
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner import eager_runner
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.eager_runner import EagerRunner
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=3, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _Model:
+    def __init__(self, remapped_ids):
+        self.remapped_ids = remapped_ids
+        self.pp_group = SimpleNamespace(is_last_rank=True)
+        self.lm_head = None
+        self.model_kwargs = None
+        self.logits_ids = None
+
+    def prepare_cp_inputs(self, forward_batch, **kwargs):
+        model_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
+        if self.remapped_ids is not None:
+            model_kwargs["input_ids"] = self.remapped_ids
+        return torch.zeros(4, 8), forward_batch.positions, model_kwargs
+
+    def model(self, input_ids, positions, forward_batch, **kwargs):
+        self.model_kwargs = kwargs
+        return torch.zeros(4, 8)
+
+    def logits_processor(self, input_ids, hidden_states, lm_head, forward_batch, aux):
+        self.logits_ids = input_ids
+        return hidden_states
+
+
+def _run(model, forward_batch):
+    runner = EagerRunner.__new__(EagerRunner)
+    runner.model_runner = SimpleNamespace(model=model)
+    sharded_ids = []
+
+    @contextlib.contextmanager
+    def fake_shard(embeds, positions, forward_batch, input_ids):
+        sharded_ids.append(input_ids)
+        yield embeds, positions, input_ids
+
+    with (
+        mock.patch.object(eager_runner, "cp_shard_model_inputs", fake_shard),
+        mock.patch.object(
+            eager_runner, "cp_gather_after_forward", lambda h, fb, stream: h
+        ),
+        mock.patch.object(torch.cuda, "current_stream", lambda: None),
+    ):
+        runner._execute_extend_cp(forward_batch, {})
+    return sharded_ids[0]
+
+
+class TestEagerRunnerCPInputs(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_ids_remapped_by_prepare_cp_inputs_reach_shard_and_logits(self):
+        """DeepSeek-V4.1 maps image pad hashes to image_token_id while preparing CP
+        inputs; the runner sharded and scored the raw ids, so Engram / hash / vision
+        routing saw unmapped image tokens."""
+        forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            input_ids=torch.tensor([7, 900001, 900002, 8]),
+            positions=torch.arange(4),
+        )
+        remapped = torch.tensor([7, 5, 5, 8])
+        model = _Model(remapped)
+        self.assertIs(_run(model, forward_batch), remapped)
+        self.assertIs(model.logits_ids, remapped)
+        self.assertNotIn("input_ids", model.model_kwargs)
+
+        plain = _Model(remapped_ids=None)
+        self.assertIs(_run(plain, forward_batch), forward_batch.input_ids)
+        self.assertIs(plain.logits_ids, forward_batch.input_ids)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
